row.notes: The broadcast grid rundown card's team badge (BroadcastGridRundownViewModel 0x1415ab930 -> card fill 0x141841a70, which declares the 'team_badge' holder at +0x1a0/+0x1a8 at 0x14184262f) is written in the driver info builder 0x141843640 at two places, both lea rcx,[rsi+0x1a0] then call 0x1407b10c0, which passes rdx (a NUL-terminated char buffer) to the string intern 0x1441974e0. rdx is not read after the call, so a MidHook may point rdx at another NUL-terminated key that lives for the run. This site (0x14184507f, rdx=[rsp+0x180] loaded at 0x141845077) is reached when the entrant has no stock team index (word [rdi-0xe] == 0x3fff): a render badge path (Team_Format_RenderBadgePath 0x141cbba30) or #overrides.default.blank. Entrants with a team go to site_Game_GridRundown_TeamBadgeSetB. Steam 26566308: 0x14184685f.
